# ePalatine SUITE

> Secure authentication portal for Banque Palatine's digital banking platform with multi-factor authentication and FIDO key support

ePalatine SUITE is the identity and access management system for Banque Palatine, a French banking institution. It provides secure login capabilities through multiple authentication methods including FIDO keys, certificates, and mobile authentication for both web and mobile banking applications.

## Key Topics

- ePalatine SUITE
- ePalatine SUITE Mobile
- Banque Palatine
- FIDO authentication
- Multi-factor authentication
- Certificate authentication
- Mobile authentication
- French banking
- Secure login
- Identity management

## Authentication Portal

- [ePalatine SUITE](https://suite.palatine.fr/): Main login portal with FIDO and multi-factor authentication for Banque Palatine
- [ePalatine SUITE Identity](https://www.identity.suite.palatine.fr/): Identity authentication portal for secure access to Banque Palatine services
